avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces erlotinib plasma concentrations by 50-60%, significantly reducing efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; do not initiate during erlotinib therapy

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer markedly decreases erlotinib bioavailability and therapeutic levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use alternative antibiotic; discontinue at least 2 weeks before erlotinib initiation

avoid_supplements.name: Phenytoin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces erlotinib concentrations and effectiveness
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid if possible; use alternative anticonvulsant or monitor erlotinib levels closely

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition may slightly elevate erlotinib levels
caution_supplements.action: Limit consumption; monitor for increased adverse effects (rash, diarrhea, nausea)

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle (silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition with potential minor increase in erlotinib exposure
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; inform oncology team of supplementation

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Increases erlotinib absorption by up to 2-fold, leading to elevated plasma concentrations and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Take erlotinib on empty stomach, 1 hour before or 2 hours after food; specifically avoid fatty foods

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases erlotinib bioavailability and risk of toxicity (rash, diarrhea)

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing beverages (coffee, tea, cola)
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP1A2 competition may slightly increase erlotinib levels, though clinical impact is minimal
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake; excessive caffeine consumption should be avoided

caution_foods.name: Charred/grilled meats
caution_foods.mechanism: Heterocyclic amines may induce CYP metabolism; generally minor clinical concern
caution_foods.action: Maintain balanced diet; no specific restriction necessary

monitoring_notes: Erlotinib requires consistent dosing on an empty stomach for optimal pharmacokinetics; food interactions are critical and significantly impact efficacy and tolerability. Monitor closely for signs of toxicity (severe rash, gastrointestinal effects, hepatic changes) and verify patient adherence to fasting recommendations and supplement avoidance.
